title: Claude turns finalize while background Task subagents are still running
outcome: src/claude_spawn.rs treats a {"type":"result"} stream message as end-of-turn, but Claude Code runs Task subagents in the background so result can arrive mid-work: the session shows idle and delegated reviewers return truncated packets (repro: session-3301 returned no findings while still compiling). Fix: track outstanding Task/tool-use ids and finalize only when none remain; until then treat a reviewer packet that admits pending work as failed.
